_comment: Populated 2026-05-11 from exploratory headed run against qa.crm.instaprotek.com. Prefer accessibility locators (role+name, label) over CSS for resilience. Buttons in the left nav have icon-font prefixes that appear in the accessible name (e.g. 'N Brand', '* Company', 'i Plans') — these prefixes are part of the name string.
_format: string for CSS selector, or object like {"role": "button", "name": "Save"} for accessibility-based locator. The orchestrator's `_locator()` understands: role+name, label, text, test_id, placeholder, or a raw CSS string.
_unknown: transaction_form.* selectors are NOT yet captured — they live inside a Batch detail page which can only be reached AFTER a batch has been created. Capture during a real first submit.

settings._brand_hierarchy_note: The CRM stores models as Brand -> Devices (two levels). Settings -> Brand shows a single-column list of Brand names. Clicking a Brand opens its detail page, which has a 'Devices' tab listing every device/model under that brand (e.g. Samsung Galaxy has 221 devices: A01, A02, A13 5G, etc.). Device names exclude the brand prefix ('Galaxy' is implicit in the brand name 'Samsung Galaxy'). The registration file's Manufacturer column maps to the Brand name and the Model Number column maps to the Device name — BOTH cells get rewritten to the exact CRM strings when the file's values don't match.
settings.brand_row_edit_button_template: row matching brand name -> 'edit' button (use brand_search_input + first row's edit button)

brand_detail._note: Inside a single Brand's detail page. Devices tab is selected by default.

company._note: There is no 'company picker' modal — Settings -> Company lands on a paginated table of all companies. Search by company name, then click the company's row cell to open its detail page.
company._new_transaction_button_note: The 'New Transaction' button is inside the Batch detail view, which requires an existing Batch. Selector not yet captured.

batch_form._note: Form fields observed in the 'New Batch' dialog opened from a Plan's Batches tab.
batch_form._plan_purchase_date_input_note: The date input has no accessible name in the snapshot — using a placeholder/format hint locator. Verify on next run; may need a CSS selector.

registrations._note: Registrations Import CSV is a GLOBAL action under /portal/registration — not scoped to a specific company. The Batch/Plan association presumably happens inside Step 2 of the 3-step Bulk Data Upload dialog (Step 1 = file picker, Step 2/3 = review + import). Capture step 2 selectors during the first real submit.

transaction_form._note: Not yet captured. The flow is: open a created Batch -> find New Transaction button -> dialog with transaction_date + effective_date inputs, select-all checkbox, Submit button. Capture during the first real submit.
